about: The evangelium of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus said to His disciples: I go to Him who sent Me, and none of you asks Me: Where are You going? But because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart. Yet I tell you the truth: it is for your good that I go. For if I do not go, the Paraclete will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you. And when He comes, He will prove the world wrong about sin, and about justice, and about judgment: about sin, because they have not believed in Me; about justice, because I go to the Father and you will no longer see Me; and about judgment, because the prince of this world has already been judged. I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now. But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will teach you all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but whatever He hears He will speak, and the things that are to come He will declare to you. He will glorify Me, because He will receive from what is Mine and will declare it to you.

a.g: I have spoken these things to you
He will prove the world wrong
He, the Spirit of truth, comes
He will speak whatever He hears
He will declare to you the things that are to come
He will receive from what is Mine
